0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak) in the Pelicans' 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with New Orleans 11th in the West and Golden State 5th. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee, tendinitis) and Yves Missi (knee, bruise), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery) and Will Richard (thumb), and Gary Payton II and Gui Santos are day-to-day with knee issues and are game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost 1-2, though New Orleans won the most recent meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
